name: subprocessors
description: subprocessors inside Claude Code: draft this codebase's GDPR sub-processor list from its code (vendors, purposes, a data guess, regions, DPA links, and the file and line each was found at), and check whether a change adds one. Open source, no account, nothing sent anywhere.

plugins.name: subprocessors
plugins.description: Draft the sub-processor list from this code and keep it current. /subprocessors:subprocessors runs `npx --allow-git=root github:agentwares/subprocessors` and turns the draft into a list for you to review: each vendor's purpose, the personal data it likely gets, where it runs and its DPA, with the evidence, and what a list from code cannot see.
